ownership.bus: The control owns no IMessageBus and invokes no handler; a future consumer owns dispatch after dequeue.
ownership.payloadLifetime: The ring owns each accepted payload until dequeue, reset, or disposal; rejected payloads remain caller-owned.
ownership.managedReferences: Consumed and dropped slots are cleared before capacity is reused; disposal clears the whole fixed array.
ownership.alignment: Managed T[] layout only; no native payload arena or alignment promise.
ownership.reclamation: Dequeue clears one slot; reset and disposal clear every slot under the same monitor.

topology.threadAffinity: Managed producers may call from worker threads; one consumer drains on the owning thread. No Unity API is called inside the queue.
topology.playerLoopPhase: No scheduling is built in; a future consumer must declare its drain phase.

ordering.linearizationPoint: Accepted enqueue and dequeue update count inside their respective monitor critical sections; cross-producer order follows monitor acquisition.

lifecycle.reset: Reset atomically discards all pending values, clears all slots, and returns the dropped count.
lifecycle.cancellation: A producer may refrain from enqueueing; individual accepted items cannot be cancelled. Reset drops the whole queue.
lifecycle.disposal: Disposal is idempotent, clears all slots, and permanently rejects later operations.
lifecycle.exceptions: No user callback runs under the monitor; failed capacity checks do not change queue state. The lock statement releases the monitor on exceptions.
lifecycle.producerAbandon: There is no reservation state; a producer that stops before TryEnqueue publishes nothing.
lifecycle.partialPublication: Each operation commits or does not commit under one monitor; no half-visible slot is exposed.

dynamicDifferences: Queued delivery defers handling and changes synchronous Emit timing; this ring alone provides no cancellation, handler lifecycle, or dispatch-equivalence contract.

decision.workload: Bounded multiple-producer, single-consumer fixed-ring laboratory control; compare against single-producer, multiple-producer, and native queue topologies at batch sizes 1, 4, 16, 64, 128, and 256 after #510 calibration.
decision.capabilityException: none; this control supplies no Burst/unmanaged capability
decision.batchOneOverhead: unmeasured; lock contention and no-contender cost require calibrated IL2CPP controls
decision.p99: N/A until #512 open-loop queued timing has independent sessions and adequate intervals
decision.retainedMemory: slot clearing asserted locally; GC-retained bytes and native memory are unmeasured
decision.playerSize: unmeasured test-only code; no production assembly addition
decision.buildTime: unmeasured test-only code; no production assembly addition
decision.stopRule: Reject on lost, duplicated, reordered-per-producer, overwritten, or retained payloads; do not promote this blocking laboratory control without a separate reviewed production contract and at least 20% gain or unique supported capability.
